p-velasca-4812765462605.d:
Laced boots with para sole, made in suede calfskin, complete a relaxed style, inspired by the bohemian way of life. Inside, the integrated insole follows the shape of your foot to give you comfort at every step; under the insole, the craftsman has inserted another soft layer to insulate the foot and make them even more comfortable. The eyelets are brass-coloured, but instead of the classic eyelets on the end of the throatline, you will find four refined hooks: they will make your boot as informal as it is memorable. Wear them with a pair of jeans with exposed selvedge, a Velasca leather belt, a white T-shirt and a warm-toned suede jacket.
Made in Montegranaro (Italy)
